input.quote: (a) In the event the Company terminates this Agreement, the Company shall pay to HDI a termination payment, (the "Termination Payment") the amount of which shall be an amount equal to the aggregate Net Sales for the twelve (12) months preceding the Termination Date less $800,000, the balance of which shall be divided by two.
input.rationale: Section 4.2 imposes a stipulated, Company-payable early-termination amount: 50% of trailing twelve-month Net Sales above $800,000, triggered by any Company termination. Because our fees under Section 3.1 are only 30% of Net Sales above $11,000 per month, this formula routinely exceeds a year's fees, so it fails the LD fallback of an early-termination fee capped at three months' fees as the sole liquidated amount. We therefore add one short subsection capping the Termination Payment at three (3) months' Section 3.1 fees and confirming it is the sole liquidated amount payable by the Company, leaving the existing formula, the $800,000 deduction and the instalment mechanic otherwise untouched.

ops.text: The Termination Payment is an early termination fee capped at three (3) months' fees payable by the Company under Section 3.1 preceding the Termination Date, and is the sole liquidated amount payable by the Company under this Agreement.

proposal.comment: [Playbook] We cannot accept a termination payment measured as half of trailing twelve-month Net Sales, which can far exceed the fees we pay HDI. Our position is no liquidated amounts payable by the Company; as a fallback we have capped the payment at three months' Section 3.1 fees as the sole liquidated amount.
proposal.summary: Cap the Termination Payment at three months' fees as an early termination fee and the sole liquidated amount

mappings.element: Customer-payable liquidated amount limited to an early-termination fee.
Early-termination fee capped at 3 months' fees.
Early-termination fee as the sole liquidated amount.
